- Added puzzle Hostile Takeover
- Discord: Quick Draft is now playable (2 players, vs a practice bot or a friend, with a choice of card pool), with per-pile pick screens, deck building and best-of-three
- Discord: new "Limited" button groups Sealed Deck and Quick Draft
- Discord: "Preview suggested deck" shows the suggested deck before you commit to it
- Discord: "All Games" button on every game screen returns to your game list when you have more than one active game, and the list now holds up to 20 games
